en: A black-and-white image showing a historic stone building with a large dome and arched windows, featuring Islamic architectural elements. Behind the domed structure, there is a visible minaret, indicating the building is likely a mosque or mausoleum. Two people are standing in front of the structure. The building is surrounded by trees and adjacent to another structure. The scene has an old, classic feel, typical of early-to-mid 20th-century postcards.
